counting_rules: Counts only public, non-owner GitHub issues that pass the external evidence gate.
Does not count private DMs, self-authored planning issues, or vague reactions.
Does not ask for raw customer data, secrets, production rows, or fake GitHub engagement.
Keeps all user, feedback, business-impact, AI-review, and star claims blocked while counts are zero.
purpose: Publish one public call for external reviewers and pilot users so future resume outcome claims can be backed by non-owner GitHub evidence instead of private messages or self-authored notes.
resume_safe_summary: Published a public reviewer call linked to 3 reviewer segments, 6 submission paths, 8 outreach tasks, and 23 evidence fields while keeping current outcome counts at zero.

reviewer_segments.ask: Run or inspect one technical path and leave implementation feedback.
reviewer_segments.who: AI Engineer, SWE, or data engineer reviewer

reviewer_segments.ask: Submit an anonymized data-quality problem and whether this agent would help triage it.
reviewer_segments.who: Data analyst, operations teammate, or student with a messy CSV workflow

reviewer_segments.ask: Open the public demo or quickstart and leave one concrete useful/confusing/broken observation.
reviewer_segments.who: Student, recruiter, or open-source reviewer with 5 minutes
